finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Not that I can see why it would overly matter if anyone had. Another thought that crossed me was also... how is the Holy Church related to the birth of the Desolate Child of Loss?”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I apologize for not being entirely straightforward, but I’m not in a position to speak freely these days. Even now, I’m constantly under surveillance, and I couldn’t be sure if anyone was still listening in before.”
